title: Telegram Managed Sprint Launcher v1 transport envelope
description: Opt-in transport contract. Validation alone never grants execution or Git publication authority. The embedded manifest is still handled by the existing Managed Sprint Engine.

project_id.description: Canonical project phone resolved from the server registry; not a caller-created alias.

autonomous_mode.description: true requests authorized automatic activation; false prepares and waits. No implicit default in this explicit envelope.
